name: v0.52.113
body:
## What's Changed
* Release exp: show requested line range in collapsed read_file tool labels (#6062) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6101
* Release exp: delegated subagent sidebar titles (#6056) + sidebar title-redaction hardening by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6103
* feat(#6033): show delegated goal titles for child sessions by @rodboev in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6056
* Release exp: hold streaming CLI-cache TTL above sidebar poll cadence (#6102) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6110
* Release exp: pinch-to-zoom for Mermaid diagrams on touch devices (#5913) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6111
* Release exp: narrow-screen CSS fixes — popup min-width (#6104) + timestamp foldable layout (#6106) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6115
* fix: ensure approval/clarify popups have min-width on narrow screens (#6094) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6104
* fix: stream event timestamps layout on narrow foldable screens (#6099) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6106
* Release exp: reparent mobile model picker to body so it never opens off-screen (#6105/#6080) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6116
* Release exp: cache GET /api/providers per-profile with short TTL (#6013) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6119
* perf(providers): cache provider list responses by @SeanWit in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6013
* Release: clear stale gateway approval attention badge (#6117) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6125
* Release: route list-shaped custom provider models (#6127) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6128
* Release: reconcile assistant-reply lifecycle docs with shipped behavior (#6144) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6147
* fix: stop closing SessionDB under live background subagents by @carlotestor in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6143
* fix(models): cap _CLI_SESSIONS_CACHE with LRU eviction (drop-oldest) by @rh-id in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6140
* docs(changelog): backfill #6143 + #6140 bullets by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6158
* fix: block stale Agent runtime after source updates by @pxxD1998 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6092
* fix(stream): cap StreamChannel per-subscriber queues (drop-oldest on full) by @rh-id in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6137
* fix(models): add defensive row backstop to display-path state.db message read by @rh-id in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6153
* Settings: preserve provider identity for duplicate model IDs by @franksong2702 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6134
* fix(#6108): retry transient SessionDB init for WebUI session_search by @rodboev in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6181
* perf(sessions): cache reconciliation message keys by @starship-s in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6182
* fix: omit unsupported Codex handoff token cap by @Gerkinfeltser in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6191
* Live Stream: recover interrupted Thinking after restart by @franksong2702 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6186
* perf(session): linearize context truncation alignment by @starship-s in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6193
* Release: msg_limit ceiling + row-loss-safe pagination (#6152 + #6154, @rh-id) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6213
* docs: fold in Rod's PR-review feedback into GUIDELINES + CONTRIBUTING by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6211
* Release: msg_limit ceiling metadata decoupling (#6214, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6216
* Release: Transparent Stream multi-segment prefix dedupe (#6189, @ai-ag2026) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6217
* Release: stop false Compressing-context card (#6184, @carlotestor) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6223
* Release: extension session-open handler + renderTranscript API (#5508, @ChonSong) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6226
* Release: durable run-journal recovery + full tool args (#6197, @franksong2702) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6236
* Release: folder-download subpath baseURI fix (#6227, @steezypunk) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6237
* Release: GLM per-version reasoning controls (#6219, @rh-id) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6243
* Release: intercept /sessions and /resume slash commands (#6245, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6253
* Release: OIDC allowlist whitespace fix (#6244, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6259
* Release: remove dead rowIndex param from settled-scene pushRow (#6258, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6262
* Release: byte-size threshold for reconnect tail optimization (#6260, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6263
* fix: deduplicate configured model badges by @happy5318 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6221
* Release: deduplicate configured model badges (#6221, @happy5318) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6268
* fix(renderer): render data:image URIs as images instead of raw base64 text by @ai-ag2026 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6209
* Release: render data:image URIs as images (#6209, @ai-ag2026) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6270
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.76 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6269
* ci: docs-only fast-path + minimal docs CI by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6279
* fix(models): prevent bare-id picker revert when provider hint is empty (#6195) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6199
* Release: prevent bare-id picker revert on empty provider hint (#6199, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6280
* Release: Artifacts filename-first + session-own-streaming + reduced-motion (#6161, #6165, #6166, @webtecnica) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6282

## New Contributors
* @SeanWit made their first contribution in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6013
* @carlotestor made their first contribution in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6143
* @rh-id made their first contribution in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6140
* @Gerkinfeltser made their first contribution in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6191

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/compare/v0.52.76...v0.52.113
